description: This file defines the implementation of the `Curl_gethostname` function, which wraps the system's `gethostname()` call to allow hostname overriding via environment variables or preloaded libraries. It handles platform-specific cases and is used for testing or hostname manipulation in the libcurl project.

methods.name: int Curl_gethostname(char * const name,GETHOSTNAME_TYPE_ARG2 namelen)
methods.description: Wraps the system call `gethostname()` to provide hostname overriding based on environment variables or shared library preloading, primarily used for testing and debugging in libcurl.
